title: Built this game using Grok 4.5, Threejs and my game dev harness
author: aniketjatav
selftext:
I have been experimenting with newer models that were launched recently. Tbh expensive but so fun as well lol. This is level 2 of my existing game, but built by Grok 4.5, a very detailed game design document and few cleanups haha. 

https://reddit.com/link/1usy7ui/video/wow8paoqigch1/player

comments.author: Sufficient-Pop-1643
comments.body: The platform with the propeller looks like something you can't get past without taking damage

replies.author: aniketjatav
replies.body: Definitely lacks in a bunch of areas, I am polishing it rn

comments.author: No-Departure-7605
comments.body: Looks Like a great Game! Good Work! Ai ist helping getting your ideas to live. ITS a strong Tool, but without the ideas it wont success!Cheers from Germany

comments.author: erratic_ostrich
comments.body:
Looks great!

But can you elaborate on how it was expensive? I thought price per token of grok was far lower than the other frontier models

replies.author: aniketjatav
replies.body: Thank you! and My bad i was implying just the overall experimentation with newer models has been expensive (Sol & Fable). Grok, like you correctly mentioned is way more affordable

replies.author: erratic_ostrich
replies.body:
Thanks for clarifying. I'm planning to test grok too this weekend, that's a relief!

And yeah, Sol is not cheap but I'm mind blowed about how well it works, this latest generation of models is insane

replies.author: aniketjatav
replies.body: Good luck on the experiment! It will be great. All the latest models are truly amazing. Their working knowledge in game dev keeps growing
